interpretation_limits.capture_efficiency: eta(E) is an effective recovery operator, not a uniquely identified condenser efficiency. Ethanol in wine is only a proxy for vapor/condensate composition.
interpretation_limits.post_hoc_status: Introduced after the constant recovery model improved wine but failed condensate timing. It is exploratory and requires prospective confirmation with condensate ethanol and outlet-gas measurements.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: All six runs have informed model development; leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation, not prospective confirmation.

literature_basis.gas_liquid_partition: Morakul et al. 2011, DOI 10.1016/j.procbio.2011.01.034; Mouret et al. 2014, DOI 10.1016/j.foodres.2014.02.044
